item.title: Denver approves $4.6M AI-powered permit review contract
item.description: The Denver City Council approved a $4.6 million contract with ComplyAI on Monday for a new online tool intended to speed up the city’s permitting process. item.title: Aurora lawmakers move forward with formalization of 72-hour homeless camp sweep notice
